correctness.rationale: Signed consecutive read-offset differences give exact within-residue-chain bit differences. Every nonconstant chain is uniquely determined; at n≥4r−1 weight three forces every constant chain of at least four positions to zero and resolves the optional unique three-position chain. Periodic one-marker phases give distinct weight-three colliders exactly when r=ceil((n+2)/4). A reproducible finite checker corroborates all test ranges.
